notes: Baseball/softball counting: full sample = 4. Seven answered reference cases were correct; a blank image and an ambiguous partial crop were withheld. Related crops/transforms share one baseball scene: this is a development smoke test, not independent-scene accuracy.

Final VQA: all 11 live requests completed. Six fresh descriptions returned bounded observations; the two known overclaim regressions were suppressed. Qualitative review does not establish complete description accuracy.
Known limitation retained: in a negative river-presence check, Original answered No while the yes/no adapter answered Yes. The adapter still makes false-positive presence errors.

The prompt-only candidate and direct-answer decoding probe did not resolve speculative descriptions and were not deployed. Current safeguards preserve raw output and omit unsupported claims; they are not a visual verifier.
NDVI agreement verifies arithmetic, masks, counts, denominators and projected area. It is not field validation of vegetation cover or cloud classification.

counting.scope: Development smoke tests: one baseball scene with related transformations/crops, a uniform image and two negative scenes. Not independent-scene counting accuracy. Ambiguous partial crop is unscored. Agreement between mirrored views is correlated, not proof of correctness.

adapter.scope: Existing adapter, 24 fresh images from official test scene, not adapter train/dev. Same frozen cases as prompt diagnostic; not an additional independent test. 64-128 visual tokens, 16 output tokens: deployment pilot settings. Baseline diagnostic used different prompts/token limits, so this is not a controlled adapter-only ablation. Published labels may be noisy; upstream model exposure unknown.

regression_tests.scope: Python scientific, routing, dispatch, answer and counting-parser tests
